```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: tbl-prim-iod-mmrm-time-since-baseline
#| tbl-cap: "Explorative MMRM for the primary endpoint Index of Desistance (IoD, total score) with the additional factor time since baseline. Time since baseline is defined as the time between the baseline measurement and the respective consecutive measurement time-point."

library(gtsummary)
library(gt)

# global theme for gtsummary
gtsummary::theme_gtsummary_journal(journal = "lancet")

tbl <- fit1_c %>%
    tbl_regression(
      add_estimate_to_reference_rows = TRUE,
      intercept = TRUE,
      label = list(
        static99_modified_calc = "Static recidivism risk",
        Aktuelle_Betreuung = "Type of supervision",
        Aktuelle_zusatzliche_Behandlung = "Additional treatment",
        Indexdelikt = "Offense type",
        IoD_baseline = "Baseline value",
        Zeit_seit_Beginn_Modul_1_in_Jahren = "Time since baseline (years)",
        treatment = "Treatment",
        timepoint = "Timepoint",
        `Timepoint * treatment` = "Timepoint * Treatment"
      )
    ) %>%
    modify_header(label ~ "**Variable**", p.value ~ "**p**") %>%
    remove_abbreviation("CI = Confidence Interval") %>%
    modify_abbreviation("CI = Confidence Interval, GCC = German Criminal Code.") %>%
    modify_column_alignment(columns = everything(), align = "left") %>%
    modify_table_styling(
        columns = c(estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
        rows = reference_row %in% TRUE,
        missing_symbol = "Ref."
    ) %>%
    bold_labels() %>%
    modify_table_body(
      ~ .x %>%
        mutate(label = case_when(
          variable %in% c("timepoint", "timepoint:treatment") ~ stringr::str_remove(label, stringr::fixed(" (post)")),
          TRUE ~ label
        ))
    )

tbl_a <- tbl %>%
    as_gt() %>%
    gt::tab_options(
      table.font.names = "Times New Roman",
          table.font.size = 10,
          quarto.use_bootstrap = FALSE,
          quarto.disable_processing = TRUE,
          data_row.padding = px(1),
          summary_row.padding = gt::px(1),
          grand_summary_row.padding = gt::px(1),
          #footnotes.padding = gt::px(2),
          #source_notes.padding = gt::px(2),
          row_group.padding = gt::px(1)
    ) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"), locations = cells_source_notes()) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(align = "left"), locations = cells_footnotes())

# save tbl as image
gt::gtsave(tbl_a, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-prim-iod-mmrm-time-since-baseline.pdf")))
gt::gtsave(tbl_a, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-prim-iod-mmrm-time-since-baseline.docx")))
gt::gtsave(tbl_a, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-prim-iod-mmrm-time-since-baseline.png")))

tbl <- tbl %>%
    as_kable_extra(
        booktabs = TRUE,
        linesep = ""
    ) %>%
    kable_styling(
        latex_options = c("scale_down", "hold_position"),
        full_width = TRUE,
        font_size = 8
    )

tbl
```

<!-- SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS -->
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| label: tbl-prim-iod-sensitivity-analysis
#| tbl-cap: "Sensitivity analysis for the primary outcome Index of Desistance (IoD total score). Summarized are the results of the reference-based multiple imputation followed by ANCOVA models for the difference in the IoD (total score) compared to baseline."
library(gt)

# global theme for gtsummary
gtsummary::theme_gtsummary_journal(journal = "lancet")

tbl <- rbmi_tab %>%
  gt() %>%
  gt::cols_label(
    "est" = "Estimate",
    "ci" = "95% CI",
    "pval" = "p",
    "parameter" = "Parameter"
  ) %>%
  # Gruppenspalte verstecken
  cols_hide(columns = group) %>%
  # Row groups über die group Spalte
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 6", rows = group == "Module 6") %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 5", rows = group == "Module 5") %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 4", rows = group == "Module 4") %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 3", rows = group == "Module 3") %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 2", rows = group == "Module 2") %>%
  tab_row_group(label = "Module 1", rows = group == "Module 1") %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.names = "Times New Roman",
    table.font.size = 10,
    quarto.use_bootstrap = FALSE,
    quarto.disable_processing = TRUE,
    data_row.padding = px(1),
    summary_row.padding = px(1),
    grand_summary_row.padding = px(1),
    row_group.padding = px(1),
    row_group.border.top.style = "none",
    row_group.border.bottom.style = "none",
    stub.border.style = "none",
    row_group.background.color = "white",
    column_labels.background.color = "white",
    table.background.color = "white"
  ) %>%
  cols_align(align = "left",   columns = parameter) %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(est, ci, pval)) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_row_groups()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(indent = px(15)),
    locations = cells_body(
      columns = parameter,
      rows = grepl("Least square mean|Group differences", parameter)
    )
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left"),
    locations = cells_source_notes()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(align = "left"),
    locations = cells_footnotes()
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "all", style = "hidden"),
    locations = cells_body()
  ) %>%
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Abbreviations: CI = Confidence Interval."
  )

# save tbl as image
gt::gtsave(tbl, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-prim-iod-sensitivity-analysis.pdf")))
gt::gtsave(tbl, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-prim-iod-sensitivity-analysis.docx")))
gt::gtsave(tbl, file = file.path(here::here("_tables/tbl-prim-iod-sensitivity-analysis.png")))

tbl
```
